purpose: Fetch one complete normalized caller-selected line range from a Python file already present in canonical LIVE scope.
parameters: file_path (string, required): exact repository-relative canonical Python path returned by search_source.
start_line (positive integer, required) and end_line (integer >= start_line, required): inclusive exact range.
allow_large_output (boolean, default false): approve output above 15360 UTF-8 bytes after confirmation preflight.
behavior: Returns the exact inclusive source range, module identity, requested range size and complete file line count. It never searches, guesses a symbol, walks the repository or reads a file outside canonical scope.
freshness: Uses current canonical scope and fails closed for unavailable or stale module truth. It is read-only and does not mutate LIVE state.
errors: Invalid paths/ranges and files outside canonical scope return controlled JSON errors. Outputs above 15360 UTF-8 bytes require allow_large_output=true retry.
usage_notes: Use the exact expand metadata returned by search_source line_map results.
